# runpod_machine (Data Source)

A single host machine looked up by identifier, with its reserved-versus-total capacity. Deprecated: Machines have no REST v2 route yet; this resource calls the GraphQL API and will be removed when a /v2/machines surface exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_machine" "rig" {
  id = "m4h2k9qzx1"
}

output "gpu_headroom" {
  description = "GPUs on the machine that are not reserved."
  value       = data.runpod_machine.rig.gpu_total - data.runpod_machine.rig.gpu_reserved
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Machine identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `cpu_count` (Number) Number of CPU cores.
- `cpu_type_id` (String) CPU flavor identifier.
- `data_center_id` (String) Always null: the 1.x GraphQL query this data source ports does not select it. Use runpod_machines for the data center.
- `disk_reserved` (Number) Disk currently reserved in GB.
- `disk_total` (Number) Installed disk in GB.
- `gpu_reserved` (Number) Number of GPUs currently reserved.
- `gpu_total` (Number) Number of GPUs installed.
- `gpu_type_id` (String) GPU type identifier of the GPUs installed in the machine.
- `host_price_per_gpu` (Number) Host price per GPU in USD/hr.
- `listed` (Boolean) Whether the machine is listed for others to rent.
- `location` (String) Location or country code the machine sits in.
- `maintenance_mode` (Boolean) Whether the machine is in maintenance mode.
- `memory_reserved` (Number) Memory currently reserved in GB.
- `memory_total` (Number) Installed memory in GB.
- `name` (String) Machine name.
- `runpod_ip` (String) Machine IP address as Runpod sees it.
- `secure_cloud` (Boolean) Whether the machine runs in secure cloud.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the machine is verified.
